subject: How meal timing and melatonin shape the aging body clock
script: From Agewell Brief: How meal timing and melatonin shape the aging body clock. A new review explains how the body's daily rhythms change with age and why meal timing and certain foods might help keep them strong. Your body runs on a roughly 24-hour cycle, orchestrated by a master clock in the brain. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
